decisions.reason: The existing message-565 MODIFY already changes commission recipient selection from a random NFT owner to a weighted draw among eligible NFT owners, fully capturing the necessary impact.
The source applies specifically to referral-free purchases and does not change ticket issuance when a referral is accepted.
The existing message-565 MODIFY already revises all current FAQ sections that describe no-referral rewards to state six tickets and weighted allocation.
The source changes allocation for referral-free purchases, not the commission paid to a chosen referrer after an accepted referral.
The source does not change which referral identifiers are valid or the prohibition on self-referrals.
The no-referral reward allocation change does not alter the NFT token serial used as the permanent referral identity or where that identity is displayed.
The source changes how tickets are created and allocated for referral-free purchases but leaves the Small Block prize amount, winner count, draw trigger, and weighted-ticket eligibility unchanged.
The current About-page state contains no specific no-referral ticket quantity or recipient rule that necessarily requires revision from this source decision.
Creating six tickets for a referral-free purchase does not change the existing rule that every active prize ticket follows its NFT upon transfer.
The current landing-page requirements describe coded-referral marketing and general prize mechanics but contain no no-referral allocation rule necessarily changed by this decision.
The source requires a weighted draw for no-referral rewards but does not specify a new randomness provider or change the existing Chainlink VRF selection requirement.
The no-referral ticket and commission allocation change does not affect the badge set, badge icons, or badge layout.
